o1.biggest_strength: It ties every choice to my numbers: taste openers first, label reads only after the sip, price said on camera, and a test plan whose budget math checks out ($72k spend, $800 × 9 = $7,200, a cut-off at the 19% label-read rate). o1.biggest_mistake: It's dense and close to the word limit. Some spoken lines are stiff, like 'Olipop paid me for this one' dropped in mid-taste-test. The price answer is weak ('12 afternoons for me'), and in Script 3 it's barely an answer at all.
o1.what_would_make_it_a_10: Give the price a real reason to pay, such as one good soda a day or less than an afternoon coffee-shop drink. Loosen the copy so it sounds warmer and more nostalgic, and trim it so creators can scan it fast.
